Name: SK's Core Engine
Author: seifkingSK
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4fWR0ek.png[/img]
[url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mqL6Uu.png[/img][/url] [url=https://smapi.io/][img]https://i.imgur.com/z1YXh1a.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][img]https://i.imgur.com/cNhm40R.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4524][img]https://i.imgur.com/RCo97LC.png[/img][/url][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UINQfef.png[/img]
[left][size=4]SK's Core Engine is the shared engine behind [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54473][color=#e69138]Junimo Bundles Plus[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54522][color=#e69138]Interactive Community Centre[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55403][color=#e69138]Living Fields[/color][/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55152][color=#e69138]SK's Core Editor[/color][/url] builds on it too. It doesn't change the game on its own: install it because one of those mods asks for it.[/size]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/TVLxM2L.png[/img][/center]
[size=4][i]- [b]Item catalog[/b]: reads every item in the game, the installed mods' items included, and sorts them by real game data (context tags, categories, seasons, where they come from, which machines make them) instead of a hardcoded list. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54473][color=#e69138]Junimo Bundles Plus[/color][/url] draws its bundles from it, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54522][color=#e69138]Interactive Community Centre[/color][/url] its order items.
- [b]Extra item tags[/b]: adds tags the game doesn't have, like fast- or slow-growing crops, rare fish, night fish and dish types, so bundles and orders can ask for them.
- [b]Gift tags[/b]: tags each item with the villagers who love it as a gift.
- [b]Item classification settings[/b]: where those tags draw their lines (how many days count as a fast crop, which fish count as rare, which words make a dish a soup), in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url] or [color=#f4f4f4]config.json[/color].[/i][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][b]Reads data from other mods[/b], when they're installed:
[i]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231][color=#e69138]Farm Type Manager[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348][color=#e69138]SpaceCore[/color][/url]: forage that mods spawn on their own maps through these counts as growing there.[/i][/size][/left]
[left][size=4][i]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792][color=#e69138]Bush Bloom Mod[/color][/url]: fruit its bushes grow counts as wild bush fruit, with its seasons and locations.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619][color=#e69138]Custom Bush[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348][color=#e69138]SpaceCore[/color][/url]: knows which bush fruit and extra crop drops can come in Silver or Gold, so bundles never ask for a quality an item can't have.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5836][color=#e69138]Deluxe Hats[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27345][color=#e69138]Skillful Clothes Revamp[/color][/url]: tags hats and clothing by the buffs and effects these mods give them (luck, speed, combat, a skill…), so rewards can ask for a certain kind.[/i][/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[center][quote][size=3][i]Doesn't do anything on its own.[/i][/size][/quote][/center]
[left][/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uohxu8h.png[/img]
[center][size=4][b][color=#e69138]1.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/][color=#e69138]SMAPI[/color][/url].
[b][color=#e69138]2.[/color][/b] (Optional) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url] for the in-game settings menu.
[b][color=#e69138]3.[/color][/b] Download this mod and drop it in your [color=#f4f4f4]Mods[/color] folder, next to the mods that need it.[/size][/center]

[left][quote][i]Making a quest, shop or gift mod in C#? Ask the catalog for "a summer or fall river fish that isn't legendary" or "any dish with a luck buff" (using tags of course) and get every matching item back, modded items included, without keeping your own item list. See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4524]API guide[/url].[/i][/quote][/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXg7DRQ.png[/img]
[left][b]Do I need it?[/b]
Only if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54473][color=#e69138]Junimo Bundles Plus[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54522][color=#e69138]Interactive Community Centre[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55403][color=#e69138]SK's Living Fields[/color][/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55152][color=#e69138]SK's Core Editor[/color][/url] ;[url=https://smapi.io/][color=#e69138]SMAPI[/color][/url] tells you when a mod needs it.

[b]Does it work on my current save?[/b]
Yes. It keeps nothing in your save.

[b]Is it safe to uninstall?[/b]
Yes, once the mods that need it are uninstalled.[/left]

Manifest.Name: SK's Core Engine
Manifest.Description: Shared item-knowledge engine for the SK suite — item catalog, derived tags, item draws and reward resolution.
